factual_claims.source_evidence: Multi-year overview (page 41) shows EBIT SEK 73,478 (2025) vs 60,677 (2024) with EBIT margin 31% vs 28%.

factual_claims.claim: Operating expenses increased 5.5% to SEK 166.2 million, primarily because the larger installed base generated higher depreciation and maintenance costs.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report (page 39) states: 'Operating expenses amounted to SEK 166.2 (157.6) million, an increase of 5.5 percent. The increased costs are primarily driven by a larger installed base, resulting in higher scheduled depreciation and increased maintenance of solar PV installations.'

factual_claims.claim: The report attributes the improvement in operating profit to stable operations and improved underlying profitability.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO Comments (page 5) state: 'Operating profit for the full year increased to SEK 73.5 (60.7) million, driven by stable operations and improved underlying profitability.'

factual_claims.claim: The Group’s net loss narrowed substantially to SEK 7.2 million from SEK 32.9 million, and earnings per share improved to negative SEK 0.13 from negative SEK 0.58.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report (page 39) states profit after tax was SEK -7.2 (-32.9) million. Note 24 (page 69) shows EPS before/after dilution of -0.13 vs -0.58.

factual_claims.claim: However, the result was affected by a negative non-cash currency effect of SEK 3.8 million and a one-off cost of SEK 3.5 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report (page 39) states: 'The exchange rate difference amounted to SEK -3.8 (1.8) million... Profit for the year amounted to SEK -7.2 (-32.9) million and were impacted by a non-cash currency effect of SEK -3.8 (1.8) million as well as a one-off cost of SEK 3.5 million.'

factual_claims.claim: Adjusted for these items, management reported profit of SEK 0.1 million, compared with an adjusted loss of SEK 34.7 million in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO Comments (page 5) state: 'Adjusted for the currency effect and the one-off item, profit amounted to SEK 0.1 (-34.7) million, a clear improvement demonstrating that our core operations are now profitable.'

factual_claims.claim: Interest expenses and similar charges declined to SEK 82.0 million from SEK 88.7 million, as the Chinese refinancing began reducing financing costs.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report (page 39) states interest expenses were SEK 82.0 (88.7) million, noting 'The refinancing in China with Agricultural Bank continues to reduce interest expenses and was approximately halfway completed by the end of the year.'

factual_claims.claim: The solar portfolio expanded during the year.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Operations section (page 16) and Board report (page 39) confirm portfolio growth to 216 installations (from 200) and capacity to 395.8 MW (from 340.1 MW).

factual_claims.claim: Installed capacity increased 16% to 395.8 MW across 216 installations, following the addition of 55.7 MW.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report (page 39) states: 'In 2025, the company installed a total of 55.7 (57.5) MW... and had 395.8 (340.1) MW installed... at the end of the year.'

factual_claims.claim: Electricity production rose 30% to 327.8 million kWh, reducing CO2-related emissions by approximately 161,000 tonnes.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report (page 39) states: 'During the year, 327.8 (252.6) million kWh were generated... reducing CO2-related emissions by approximately 161,000 (124,000) tonnes.'

factual_claims.claim: The company signed 17 contracts totaling approximately 41.8 MW, but signed orders at year-end fell to 18.9 MW from 38.8 MW.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report (page 39) states: 'The Company signed 17 (15) contracts representing total installed capacity of 41.7 (56.6) MW... At the end of 2025, the company had 16.4 (38.8) MW in signed orders.'

factual_claims.claim: Financing remained central.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Risks section (page 30) and refinancing details (pages 65-66) emphasize financing as a critical ongoing concern.

factual_claims.claim: Gigasun secured additional refinancing of approximately SEK 372 million at a 3.60% interest rate and extended the SOLT4 bond’s maturity to 8 November 2026.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report (page 39) and Note 16 (page 65) detail: 'The company has entered into an agreement... to refinance approximately SEK 372 million (CNY 280 million)... The remaining bond, SOLT4, has been extended to November 8, 2026.'

factual_claims.claim: Interest-bearing debt declined to SEK 1.383 billion from SEK 1.483 billion, but the equity ratio weakened to 21% from 23%, cash fell to SEK 45.1 million from SEK 89.9 million, and total cash flow turned negative at SEK 34.9 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Balance Sheet (page 43) shows interest-bearing debt SEK 1,382,613 (2025) vs 1,483,061 (2024). Equity ratio 21% vs 23%. Cash SEK 45,149 vs 89,889. Statement of Cash Flows (page 46) shows cash flow SEK -34,902 vs 68,305.

factual_claims.claim: Management stated that further financing during 2026 is important to execute the business plan and that failure to secure it would create significant uncertainty regarding continued operations.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Going Concern section (page 53) states: 'If the company is not successful with new financing, the company believes that there is significant uncertainty regarding going concern in the current business plan.'
